findings.title: Website privacy restriction is bypassed by website_name
findings.body: `website` is an untrusted attribute, so it is omitted for anonymous viewers of TL0 users when `restrict_user_fields?` applies. The newly serialized `website_name` is not in `untrusted_attributes`, and its inclusion method lacks the `?` used by the serializer's inclusion checks. It therefore still exposes the website host—and sometimes its path—in the user JSON, bypassing the existing privacy restriction.
